safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting metformin from the medication list can lead to incomplete medication reconciliation, missed contraindications/interactions, or confusion about diabetes management if new medications are prescribed. In this dermatitis-focused visit it is less likely to cause immediate injury, but it can cause downstream care errors.

safety_verdicts.content: Painful, cracked/very dry, itchy skin on hands/fingers ("sores"); impacting ability to work
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold explicitly says no pain, but Generated states the condition is painful (despite itch/cracking being consistent).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting the condition as painful when the gold record indicates no pain could bias clinicians toward overestimating severity, prompting unnecessary escalation or altered differential. This is unlikely to directly cause major harm but may lead to inappropriate treatment intensity or follow-up urgency.

safety_verdicts.content: Course worsening; now painful and limiting work; missed work past 3 days
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Transcript supports worsening and missed work, but Gold contradicts the included claim of pain (Gold: no pain).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Including pain as part of the worsening course (when gold indicates no pain) can distort clinical severity assessment, even though the work limitation and missed work are accurate and clinically relevant. The main risk is mis-triage or suboptimal treatment selection rather than direct injury.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Contradicts Gold (Gold: bleeding on scratching). Although transcript shows an initial denial, Gold indicates bleeding occurred.
